summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Tungray Technologies Inc, a Cayman Islands exempted company foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its 2026 annual general meeting held on July 1, 2026. The filing details that a quorum was reached and shareholders voted to re-elect five directors and ratify the appointment of the independent auditor. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or strategic reviews. The filing is a routine annual meeting report with no event triggering a reclassification, and the company is reporting required information to the SEC.
